definitions.operation_js_commit_ms: Browser performance.now elapsed from state mutation through the framework's synchronous commit (React flushSync) or queued DOM commit (Vue nextTick), excluding the subsequent shared DOM assertion and paint.
definitions.view_teardown.wall: Native steady-clock wall duration of View destruction after populated capture; separate from JS operation timings, workload wall and the runner's full process wall.
definitions.cpu_offscreen_frame.generated_tick_wall: Native steady-clock wall duration of workload View::Tick calls whose frame generation advanced; excludes the later populated-capture verification and is software offscreen output, not onscreen/vsync FPS.
definitions.cpu_offscreen_frame.throughput_per_cpu_t: Workload frame generation advance divided by summed wall time inside generation-producing workload View::Tick calls; excludes the later populated-capture verification and is software CPU offscreen throughput, not onscreen/vsync FPS.
definitions.p95_nearest_rank: Sort ascending and select element ceil(0.95*N), using one-based rank.
definitions.median: Arithmetic midpoint of the one or two central sorted observations.
